about: Demo events for scripts/seed-demo-data.mjs. `source` holds what the cited pages said on crawledAt (prices in VND, times Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh). `seed` is how the seeder models it in EventPass. `assumptions` lists every value NOT taken from a source (estimated capacity, end time, etc.) so it can be checked later. Entries with `generated: true` are not real events — they are plausible placeholders for features no real listing covered (free entry, free registration, a rejected submission). `skipped` entries were crawled but not seeded, with the reason. Titles in `seed.title` are cleaned up Ticketbox-style (date/source suffixes dropped — the date is shown separately); the original stays in `source.title`.
